purpose: ticket 25: per-step geometry ladder for four Juglet pieces, three dump arms, plus the unset-defaults identity proof and its run-to-run control

arms.B: SFS_DUMP_STAGE set; defaults (0.6 mm density step, paper chain on)
arms.E: SFS_DUMP_STAGE set; SFS_PAPER_CHAIN=0 and SFS_DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET=-1 (native density)
arms.A: SFS_DUMP_STAGE unset; new binary; first run
arms.A2: SFS_DUMP_STAGE unset; new binary; second run (run-to-run control)
arms.EOLD: SFS_DUMP_STAGE unset; pre-change binary; SFS_PAPER_CHAIN=0 and SFS_DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET=-1

identity_statistic: sorted multiset of six-column point lines (x y z nx ny nz) per written surface, compared between arms; md5 is NOT used because the exported PLY carries an uninitialised curvature column
geometry_deletion: each cell deletes its staged tree when it finishes and appends per-extension counts and bytes to out/cells/geometry_counts.tsv; out/GEOMETRY_DELETED.txt totals them. Kept: out/dump/** and every cell's surfaces/, because the ladder dumps are the deliverable
build: git archive <sha> | tar -x into <run>/build/<arm>/src, then cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release and make MeshPreprocessingHeadless inside the container
